title: AI Agent Oversight Policy
summary: Policy governing the operation, supervision, and auditing of autonomous AI agents within the Bhavya OS runtime.

sections.heading: Supervision Requirements
sections.body: All autonomous AI agents must operate under human supervision with explicit capability contracts defining scope, permissions, and termination conditions.

sections.heading: Audit Trail
sections.body: Every agent action must be logged with immutable timestamp, actor identity, action type, and resource reference in the institutional audit log.
